coverage.population: 27 recorder sites represented in the weekly tables, selected from the study’s 28 sites in Norway; public coordinates were randomized by ±0.01 degrees
coverage.included: 1587 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: No global flyway census, inferred bird paths, individual counts or modelled species-distribution rasters. The source site table has 28 sites; weekly files contain27.
coverage.missingness: Each species has 260 explicit missing-effort rows and 38 additional site-week combinations absent from the source files (27 sites×21weeks=567potential combinations; 529 present). All absent combinations remain unknown, not zero.

uncertainty: BirdNET confidence threshold >0.80 removed 81% of all detections; non-detection does not establish absence. Precision is estimated, recall is not. Article Results reports 100% precision for the three selected species, while archive v4 validation CSV gives Spotted Flycatcher 96% correct / 1% incorrect / 3% unsure. These validation sources may differ in period/denominator and must not be combined; no precision rate is encoded as a row measure. Each species has260 of 529 site-weeks with missing effort, explicitly null. Source weeks 10–30 are retained; main paper migration analysis was April 1–June 30,2022. Public coordinates are randomized by ±0.01 degrees.

transform.description: Retrieve five selected CSV members from the public CC BY archive using HTTP range reads; preserve member SHA256s. Normalize three complete weekly files. Convert missing effort to null detection and null tag count. Retain source week numbers without asserting ISO date boundaries. Preserve approximate source coordinates, which were randomized by ±0.01 degrees; never reverse this privacy protection.
transform.validation: 1587 rows=3×529;807 observed-effort records and 780 explicitly missing. Weekly source files have 27 unique sites; public site table has 28. All effort fractions in (0,1].

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
